transcript.t: Ben, why are you taking so much cash to the market?
I always do. I think it is safer than using my phone.
But e-payment is very convenient. I have not carried cash for a year.
Really? How do you pay for vegetables?
I just scan the code with my phone. It takes only two seconds.
What if the phone runs out of power?
Then I bring a small charger. Now even the old farmer at the market uses a digital code.
OK, you have convinced me. Show me how to do it.
